description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCart entity class used in an e-commerce platform, representing a shopping cart with its associated properties, relationships, and metadata annotations.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Java entity class representing a shopping cart, including fields for store, customer, line items, and audit information, mapped to the database via JPA annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: getLineItems
methods.description: Returns the set of line items associated with the shopping cart.

methods.name: setLineItems
methods.description: Assigns a set of line items to the shopping cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Retrieves the unique shopping cart code assigned to the cart.

methods.name: setShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Sets the unique shopping cart code.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the cart.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Associates a customer ID with the shopping cart.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the shopping cart.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the shopping cart.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if all items in the cart are obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks the shopping cart as obsolete or active.
